entries.title: A part of a task no longer stays under a task in another project
entries.body: When your first mate moves one part of a larger task to another project, it now moves the whole task with its parts, or takes that part out of the task in the same step. A task no longer shows a part that belongs to a different project.
entries.noPicture: The change decides which tasks move together; no view or control changes, and a part under a parent elsewhere looked like any other part.
